name: Auburn University
description:
Auburn University is a public land-grant university in Auburn, Alabama. One of the largest universities in the South, it offers over 150 majors to choose from within thirteen colleges and schools. Students also have the choice of nine Top-100 engineering programmes, plus collaboration opportunities with Coca-Cola, KIA and NASA.

Chartered in 1856, Auburn University has a rich history of success. Today, Auburn welcomes international students into the community with strong traditions and unmatched school spirit.

What is the Auburn University acceptance rate for International Students?

The Auburn University acceptance rate is 71.2%.

As the best university in Alabama, Auburn University has a wealth of resources for students to take advantage of while studying here. The university has many athletics facilities, from the Neville Arena to the Jordan-Hare stadium.

Student Life

The campus is known for providing stunning scenery as it was once voted the prettiest campus in the country and still provides plenty of green space alongside opportunities to socialize. Yoga, tailgates, and more events occur throughout the year in the Student Center space. The recreation and wellness center is open to students all year, and there are more than 500 student organizations to get involved with. The Greek community is active in the community and students have access to a range of dining options to cater for all dietary preferences. Overall, campus life is vibrant and full of activity.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The university has several residence halls on campus where students can enjoy a traditional dormitory-style living experience. These halls are often organized by gender, academic class or theme. Similarly, there are various off-campus housing options available to students, including apartments, houses and townhomes. The university actively wants students to be matched with the best living experience for their requirements. Living learning communities bring together students with similar interests to live in communities where they can participate in activities supporting their academic interests.

Family housing is available for students with a family. Similarly, graduate housing tends to be in townhomes or apartments. Many fraternities and sororities have their own housing options - the university has a sizeable Greek system.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: The university has seriously invested in these sports facilities so students can play and watch sports from basketball to American football and beyond. Several libraries reside on campus to provide students studying different disciplines to find the correct information when they need it.
